proposed_widenings.name: grant_environmental_temperature_immunity
proposed_widenings.justification: Ring of Warmth prevents harm from extreme ambient cold, which is broader than incoming damage reduction and is not representable by any existing surface atom or v4 atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower"

notes: Authored subset encodes the worn passive cold-damage reduction honestly. The environmental-temperature rider was omitted and documented in proposal-magic_item_ring_of_warmth.md.
